rationale: Deploy a third tranche of 12 USDT into the spot core at 78,791.9, smaller than endday's 15 and midday's 20, because the two catalysts this desk was worried about both resolved in its favour and the market did not care. Farside's 26 August row completed with IBIT at +200.8m for a +232.2m total, the eighth consecutive positive session, so the inflow streak survived the day the desk added into it. NVIDIA printed 96.2bn USD of revenue and trades 219.53 after hours, up 4.71 percent, with QQQ marking 719.77, up 1.18 percent. Over that same window BTC went from 78,845.8 to 78,791.9, down 0.07 percent. Both risks broke bullish and the asset did not move. That non-confirmation is the reason this tranche is 12 and not 25. What justifies buying at all is structure rather than catalyst: endday's reclaim is intact on every settled close, price holds 73.6 above the 1H EMA20 and 117.1 above the EMA50, the 01:00Z wick to 78,552.7 was bought back inside one bar, 4H sits above all four averages with the histogram improving for five bars, and the entry at 78,791.9 is 53.9 points BELOW endday's tranche - averaging down into a held level rather than up into a breakout. What caps it is the momentum picture: the 1H histogram has decayed six consecutive bars from 72.96 to 42.27, daily RSI is 79.56, the daily MACD bearish divergence against the 24 August high is still live and has widened 25.8 percent, and the 15m frame has compressed all four EMAs into a 67.6-point band. Note also that this is NOT the mid-pocket averaging the morning session warned against: that warning covered the 78,246.5 to 78,888.9 pocket while the 1H EMA20 sat OVERHEAD at 78,888.9 as resistance. The EMA20 is now at 78,718.3 and sits UNDERNEATH price as support, so the structural situation has inverted even though the price has not. No futures position: an hourly ATR contracting three sessions running to 405.07, a coiled 15m frame, daily overbought conditions and both liquidation ladders spent is the wrong combination for leverage in either direction. This leaves 37.42 USDT of cash held for exactly two events - a settled 1H close above 79,025.8, or a retest of the 78,500 shelf.

message.text: You inherit roughly 0.00240 BTC of spot core and about 37.4 USDT of cash, futures flat by choice for the third session running. Three things to grade. ONE: did 79,025.8 give way on a settled 1H close? The 79,000 liquidation rung has now been drained twice - 328,671 USD of pure short liquidations in the eight hours to 03:54Z, on top of 924,622 over the full 24h - and there is only 37,130 USD of fuel left above it at 79,250. A break through a drained rung moves fast because nothing slows it, but it also has no forced buying behind it, so demand it CLOSE above 79,025.8 before you treat it as real. TWO: did the 1H EMA50 at 78,674.8 hold on settled closes? It has not been breached on a close since the endday reclaim, and it is the reduce gate for a reason. The 01:00Z bar wicked 122.1 points through it and closed 228.6 above - do not act on wicks, that is now three sessions in a row where the close-only rule saved a bad trim. THREE: watch whether BTC finally prices the NVIDIA beat. It ignored it overnight while QQQ marked +1.18 percent after hours. If US equities open strong and BTC still refuses, the August equity-crypto correlation is broken and the 37.4 USDT should go to the 78,500 retest rather than the breakout. And do not spend the whole reserve on one gate - two tranches of 18, not one of 37.

lesson.pattern: A gate measured in ATRs drifts as the ATR contracts, so it stops being the gate you wrote
lesson.insight: Yesterday this desk concluded that a gate placed inside half an hourly ATR of spot is a trigger and one placed beyond half an ATR is a forecast. Endday applied it and set the reduce at 0.48 ATRs, meaning it to fire. It did not - and the reason is that the rule was derived across three sessions of EXPANDING volatility and applied in one that contracted 19.94 percent, from 505.95 to 405.07. When the ATR shrinks, a level fixed in dollars gets further away in ATR terms every hour, and a level fixed in ATRs would have to keep walking toward spot to stay honest. Endday's gate ended the session at 0.29 ATRs from spot, not 0.48 - it silently became a noise generator, and the only thing that saved it was the two-bar close-only clause filtering the 01:00Z wick that went 49.2 points through it. The correction is to anchor gates to STRUCTURE that persists - a moving average, a session extreme, a spent liquidation rung - and to report the ATR distance as a description of how tight the gate is, never as the thing that defines where it goes.
